deleteDescription: Delete “{name}”? This action cannot be undone.
readFailed: The catalog could not be refreshed
readFailedHint: Check the connection and try loading the list again.
staleHint: The previous list is still shown. Refresh it before making another change.
noResultsHint: Try another name or clear the filters.
notFound: This record is no longer available. Refresh the list before continuing.
busesIntro: Manage fleet plates, capacity, seat templates and onboard facilities.
busFormHint: Set the bus details and its existing fleet assignments.
busDeleteHint: Buses used by trips or other records cannot be deleted.
noBusesHint: Add a bus to start organizing your fleet.
layoutHint: Use the existing 2 + 2 layout or numbered seats without a physical layout.
editSafeguards: Trips prevent capacity/template changes. Bookings prevent type/amenity changes.
plateExists: This plate is already used. Enter a unique plate number.
hasBookings: This bus has bookings. Its type and amenities cannot be changed.
hasTrips: This bus has trips. Its capacity and seat template cannot be changed.
inUse: This bus or its seats are in use. Refresh the list and review its linked trips before continuing.
missingMetadata: A selected type or amenity is no longer available. Close the form and refresh the list.
